propositions: Comment sync currently identifies comments by normalized-body equality, causing collisions and false-positive matches on edited bodies
The system must establish identity as persistent COMMENT-HLC→Jira-comment-ID map stored in binding_store, not body content
Outbound and inbound comment sync must each use their own authoritative identity store (map vs jira_comment_id) without collision
Returned Jira comment IDs from add_comment must be captured at both enactment sites (create_one and update_one) and persisted immediately with write-ahead save for crash durability

Outbound comment bodies must render through the real RichTextCodec (ADF on Cloud, WikiText on DC) with fit-then-encode ordering, and the dedup-key codec must be migrated from IdentityCodec to the real codec
Comment sync must be append-only in both directions—new comments sync once, edits and deletes are never propagated
